pages.title: Auth API v1 Deprecation Plan
pages.content:
# Decision

Auth Service will remove Auth API v1 and POST /v1/auth on 2026-10-01. Auth API v2 and POST /v2/auth replace the v1 contract. The reason is that v2 uses the new scoped-token format required by the security program.

## Known consumers

MCP Gateway consumes Auth API v1 through src/auth_client.py. Argo Orchestrator consumes Auth API v1 through src/token_client.py. Both projects are potentially broken by the removal until their repositories stop calling /v1/auth.

Tracking tickets: AUTH-900, MCP-150, ARGO-250.
